local_goals.local_statement: 在忙碌周或只需补常规库存时，用线上采购替代去实体店，以节省时间。
local_context: 触发条件一：当周安排很忙、没有时间亲自到店
触发条件二：只需买固定不变的常规商品、无需探索或挑选新品
履约方式偏好：到店自提（免配送费、门店离家近）而非配送
自评频率：约每两周一次，不固定
paper_statements: Enable time-saving for users with busy schedules.
Allow users to choose between online and in-person shopping.
Optimize efficiency in online grocery shopping.
Support item pickup to reduce shipping costs.
Save time by avoiding unnecessary wandering through store aisles.
Streamline the shopping process.
Enable users to reorder regular items without exploring new options.
